validation.configurations: 6 operations x full/split x GCC/Clang x checked/skip x native/standard fallback =96.

independent_references.orientation: Python arbitrary integers: exact cross, dot and squared lengths.
independent_references.segment_intersection: Python arbitrary integer determinant straddling plus exact coordinate bounding boxes.
independent_references.area: Python integer shoelace sum on valid simple CCW polygons.
independent_references.contains: Independent integer winding number plus exact boundary checks on x-monotone simple polygons. Includes all vertices and outside/interior queries.
independent_references.circle_relation: Python squared-distance comparisons to (r+s)^2 and (r-s)^2; all five outputs, concentric unequal circles, squared-distance differences of1 near contact.
independent_references.point_segment_distance: Exact Fraction projection region and squared distance; Decimal sqrt at55 digits. Exact segment intersection determines zero.

validation.comparison: All non-distance outputs token-exact, distance absolute error≤1e-8 and finite as specified by AOJ; no relative-error relaxation.

orientation.work: O(q)、追加O(1)。orientationの符号、共線時の内積・距離を照合。

segment_intersection.work: O(q)、追加O(1)。閉線分交差を直接出力。

area.work: O(N)、頂点配列O(N)。三角形・凹形を含む反時計回り単純多角形。

contains.work: O(Nq)、頂点配列O(N)。最大10万辺照会。

circle_relation.work: O(1)。異なる円のみ。中心間二乗距離と半径和/差の二乗により独立参照。

point_segment_distance.work: O(q)、追加O(1)。1照会で最大4つの点・線分距離。非零長線分のみ。

yukicoder_candidates.title: 障害物競プロ
yukicoder_candidates.gap: Requires visibility-graph endpoint/along-obstacle boundary handling and all-pairs shortest paths over≤300 vertices. Natural primitive usage, but much larger additional processing than a direct API Verify.
yukicoder_candidates.decision: Not adopted in this scope by root/user priority follow-up; retain existing AtCoder intersection Verify.

yukicoder_candidates.title: 点と三角柱の内外判定
yukicoder_candidates.constraints: 4 3D integer points, coordinates±1e6; projected point at least0.01 from triangle edges;1.5 seconds.
yukicoder_candidates.gap: Tests only triangles and requires independent3D projection; does not naturally replace arbitrary2D polygon input or boundary classification coverage.

yukicoder_candidates.title: 三角形の面積
yukicoder_candidates.constraints: T≤100,radius1..100; maximum area of an inscribed triangle; abs/relative tolerance1e-4;2 seconds.
yukicoder_candidates.applicable_api: Could construct a regular triangle and evaluate area.
yukicoder_candidates.gap: Synthetic regular-triangle coordinates rather than input vertices. Reduces the arbitrary-integer triangle coverage; the radius formula alone solves it.

final_decision.search_scope: Bounded primary-page follow-up, not a claim that no suitable Yukicoder problem could ever exist.
